soldier: The soldier has the head capsule yellowish brown, the colour in front of the frontal ridges nearly brown and fading backwards, mandibles deep brown, labrum and antennae brownish yellow, eye spots yellow, postmentum reddish brown with the sides of the anterior part darker; pronotum brown, slightly deeper than the back of the head capsule, the rest cream yellow. The whole body very sparsely haired. Head capsule rectangular and rather thick, the sides roughly parallel and slightly concave at the middle, the anterolateral angles slightly rounded, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded, the posterior margin nearly straight; the frontal surface steep, meeting the vertex at almost a right angle, at their junction two forward-leaning mound-like projections whose distance apart is about the width of the clypeus, slightly depressed and longitudinally wrinkled between them, the Y-shaped suture very indistinct. Mandibles short, the outer margin slightly swollen at the base, the tip of the left mandible slightly curved inwards, with three triangular marginal teeth whose tips are directed inwards, the right with two, both tips rather sharp. Labrum flat and trapezoidal, reaching only half the length of the mandibles. Antennae with 11–12 segments, if 11 then the third has a ring and is as long as the second; eye spots very small and dot-like, their diameter less than their distance to the antennal socket. The anterior part of the postmentum about one-third of the total length, the narrowest part at the posterior end. Pronotum slightly wider than the head, the sides sloping downwards in an arc, the anterior margin with a deep V-shaped concavity and a median notch, the posterior margin narrow with a shallow median concavity, hind legs stout and short.
